ledger.what: remove cookie/consent chrome (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, generic cookie-banner ids/classes, any cookie/consent/gdpr-named element inside a fixed/sticky/high-z overlay)
ledger.why: overlay chrome injected by a CMP, not page content; re-added at deploy time

ledger.what: de-carousel slick/swiper/splide/glide: remove clone slides, force real slides visible+static, drop dots/arrows
ledger.why: hidden slides are absent from innerText and clones duplicate it — rotating carousels break byte determinism; the reskin renders all slides statically in DOM order

ledger.what: open every .nsw-accordion panel (unhide its content region, aria-expanded=true)
ledger.why: closed panel text is content; capture-only — the rendered accordion keeps the closed rest state

metadata.title: Parent portal
metadata.description: At Fort Street High School, we use parent portal apps to communicate to our families. Our apps are for student attendance matters, booking parent and teacher interviews, accessing academic reports, making payments, viewing financial records and giving parental consent for school events.

visibleTextNormalized: HomeSchool lifeParent portal Parent portal At Fort Street High School we use parent portal apps to make communication and admin easier for families. These tools help you: make payments quickly and securely view academic reports stay up to date with school events record absences. Our parent portal apps Sentral Sentral is used for communication from teachers, attendance and reports. Parents will receive instructions on how to access the Sentral Parent Portal and will be given an access key at the beginning of Term 1. Once setup you can access the portal here (opens in new window) . Sentral For student attendance matters, booking parent and teacher interviews and accessing academic reports. Log-in to the Sentral portal or: Download Sentral on Google Play (opens in new window) Download Sentral on the Apple Store (opens in new window) School Bytes School Bytes is used for payments and permission notes for excursions. Parents can setup their own School Bytes by following the instructions provided here (opens in new window) . School Bytes For making payments, viewing financial records and giving parental consent for school events. Log-in to the School Bytes portal or: Download School Bytes on Google Play (opens in new window) Download School Bytes on the Apple Store (opens in new window) Other communications Email General information is also often distributed to parents and students via email. Please ensure that you inform the school if your details change. Mercurius The school newsletter (known as “Mercurius”) is published every 3 weeks and emailed to students, parents and carers. Copies are also published on the school website, where you can also view past issues. The Fortian The school magazine (“The Fortian”) is produced each year as a record of student achievements. Mr Chapman oversees a student team of editors from Years 10 and 11, and all students are encouraged to submit work for inclusion. Social Media The school also has an account on Facebook (opens in new window) and Instagram (opens in new window) . Interpreter and Translation Services Parents and carers may ask the school for an interpreter to be present when discussing matters involving their children. Interpreters can also be asked to be present at school meetings or parent-teacher interviews. Non-English-speaking parents, carers and community members can also use the Translating and Interpreting Service on 131 450. Need help with our parent portal apps? Our friendly office staff will be happy to give you a hand. lines: We recognise the Ongoing Custodians of the lands and waterways where we work and live. We pay respect to Elders past and present as ongoing teachers of knowledge, songlines and stories. We strive to ensure every Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander learner in NSW achieves their potential through education.
